Thank you for participating in this interview. To start, I would like to understand the high-level goals for the modernization of the Legacy Bank mobile app. 

What are the primary objectives you aim to achieve with this modernization project?

Thanks for having me. Well, honestly, I just want an app that feels more up-to-date and fast, like Revolut. It would be great to get notifications as soon as money leaves my account and have control over my card—like being able to freeze it if I lose it. Those are the main things that come to mind for me.

Thank you for sharing your thoughts. It sounds like you are looking for an app that not only feels modern but also provides real-time features for better control over your banking activities. 

To clarify, when you mention wanting notifications as soon as money leaves your account, can you explain what specific types of transactions you would like to be notified about? For example, would you like notifications for all transactions, or just significant ones?

Yeah, I’d want notifications for all transactions, not just the big ones. I want to know instantly about everything—like purchases, payments, anything that affects my balance. It just helps me keep track, you know?

I understand that having immediate notifications for all transactions, including purchases and payments, is important to you for better tracking of your finances. 

Now, regarding the ability to freeze your card if you lose it, could you elaborate on how you envision this feature working? For instance, would you want the option to freeze and unfreeze the card directly within the app, and should there be any specific security measures or confirmation steps involved in that process?

Definitely, I want to be able to freeze and unfreeze my card right in the app. It should be super easy—just a button to click. No complicated steps or having to call anyone. Just a quick way to feel secure if I misplace my card, you know? I haven't really thought about extra security measures, as long as it's straightforward and fast.

Thank you for that clarification. So, you would like a straightforward feature in the app that allows you to freeze and unfreeze your card with just the click of a button, ensuring a quick and secure experience without complicated steps.

Moving on to budgeting tools, would you be interested in features that help you set spending limits or track your expenses categorically? If so, what specific functionalities would you find most beneficial in managing your budget?

Yeah, budgeting tools would be really helpful. I think being able to set monthly spending limits for different categories, like groceries or dining out, would be great. And if I could get alerts when I'm getting close to those limits or if I go over, that would really help me manage my spending better. Just something simple and clear, you know?

I appreciate your input. To summarize, you would like budgeting tools that allow you to set monthly spending limits for various categories, such as groceries and dining out. Additionally, receiving alerts when you're approaching or exceeding those limits would be beneficial for managing your spending effectively.

Now, regarding the integration with the existing core banking system, are there any specific limitations or restrictions you foresee that we should be aware of, especially concerning regulatory compliance or technical constraints?

Honestly, I haven't really thought about those kinds of limitations or regulations. I'm more focused on how the app works for me day-to-day. I just want it to be user-friendly and do what I need without any hassle. So, I guess I wouldn't know what to look out for there.

I understand that your primary focus is on the user experience and ensuring that the app is user-friendly and meets your daily needs without hassle. It’s perfectly valid to prioritize these aspects.

So far, we have identified several clear requirements for the modernization of the mobile app: 

1. Immediate notifications for all transactions that affect your balance.
2. The ability to freeze and unfreeze your card easily through a button in the app.
3. Budgeting tools that allow users to set monthly spending limits for different categories and receive alerts when approaching or exceeding those limits.

Now, just to confirm, are there any additional features or functionalities you believe would enhance your banking experience in the app?

Hmm, I think those are the main things I really want. But if I could also see all my accounts in one place, that would be great—like checking my current balance, savings, and credit cards all on one screen. That way, I wouldn’t have to jump around different sections of the app. It just makes everything easier to manage.

Thank you for that valuable input. To summarize, you would like the ability to view all your accounts — including current balances for checking, savings, and credit cards — consolidated on one screen for easier management. 

With this addition, I now have five clear requirements for the modernization of the mobile app:

1. Immediate notifications for all transactions that affect your balance.
2. The ability to freeze and unfreeze your card easily through a button in the app.
3. Budgeting tools that allow users to set monthly spending limits for different categories and receive alerts when approaching or exceeding those limits.
4. A consolidated view of all accounts, including current balances for checking, savings, and credit cards, on one screen.

REQUIREMENTS_COMPLETE
